subject: Cloud broker 'sell-with' measurement framework and integration asks
messages:
From: Ethan Shaw <ethan@cloudbrokers.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: GCP Marketplace Team <mp-sales@gcpcloud.example>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Syndicated listing + sell-with metrics — request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking the call last week. CloudBrokers is ready to move forward with a syndicated listing and a joint sell-with program on GCP, but our internal ops team needs a concrete measurement framework so we can align incentives and track uplift.

Specifically, they want: 1) the list of signals Redwood can emit (trial starts, demos booked, qualified leads, co-sell referrals), 2) an agreed attribution window, and 3) a lightweight telemetry mapping to our SKU/usage events for co-selling credit.

Can you share a template or suggested matrix and confirm any sensitive audit/telemetry we should avoid sending to the marketplace connector? We want to start a two-week pilot and would like to lock the metrics and a rough timeline by Tues.

Attached: none (we'll send our internal product mapping once you confirm fields).

Best,
Ethan
Partnerships, CloudBrokers Inc
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan@cloudbrokers.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated listing + sell-with metrics — request

Hi Ethan — thanks, we can do that. Looping in Ben (partner ops), Vivek (alliances), and Monica (marketplace onboarding) so we can move quickly.

High level: Redwood can emit event-level signals and an aggregated attribution bucket. We typically avoid sending user PII to marketplace connectors; event-level IDs and timestamps are fine. Vivek — can you put together a starter measurement matrix? Ben/Monica — can you confirm the normal attribution windows we recommend and whether the marketplace connector needs a transformed SKU map?

Proposed timeline: initial matrix by Monday EOD, alignment call Tuesday, pilot start next week. Does that work for everyone?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Channel GTM, Redwood Inference
redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Ethan Shaw <ethan@cloudbrokers.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated listing + sell-with metrics — request

Kimberly / team — quick ops questions so we don't block the pilot:

- Attribution windows: we usually recommend 30d for trial-to-paid and 90d for demo->contract attribution. Are those acceptable to CloudBrokers?
- SKU mapping: CloudBrokers will need a mapping table (marketplace SKU -> Redwood offer SKU). Do they want raw usage events or aggregated counters? (aggregated counters are safer for compliance)
- Telemetry: we will NOT send PII or full user-level transcripts. We can provide event_id, event_type, timestamp, offer_id, and an optional hashed customer_id. Is a SHA256 hash acceptable on their side?

I'll draft a measurement_matrix.xlsx and attach the first pass. Monica — can you add the marketplace onboarding checklist (mp-onboarding-checklist.pdf) so CloudBrokers has the gating items?

Ben Carter
Director, Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
[attachment: measurement_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Shaw <ethan@cloudbrokers.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Syndicated listing + sell-with metrics — request

Thanks — attaching a lightweight framework and some scoring guidance. High level recommendations:

- Core signals (we propose sending these):
  • lead.created (aggregated per day)
  • demo.scheduled (count + timestamp)
  • trial.started (count + offer_id)
  • trial.converted (count, revenue_bucket)
  • co-sell.referral (referral_id, timestamp)

- Attribution model: Primary credit to marketplace if conversion occurs within 30 days of lead.created; assist credit if within 90 days. Use last-touch for revenue attribution in the pilot.
- Privacy: send only hashed customer_id (sha256), no raw emails or transcript text. Event IDs should be UUIDs not user emails.
- Measurement KPIs for the pilot: #co-sell referrals, conversion rate of referred leads, incremental ARR attributable to co-sell, and time-to-first-demo.

Action items and owners: 
- Ben: finalize measurement_matrix.xlsx (attached).
- Monica: share marketplace gating checklist to CloudBrokers and confirm any legal/contract items for co-sell.
- Kimberly: schedule Tue alignment (30min).

[Vivek attached: measurement_matrix.xlsx]

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — this is perfect. A few quick notes from CloudBrokers ops after reviewing the matrix:

- 30/90 attribution windows are fine.
- We prefer aggregated counters for the pilot (daily rollups); we'll ask for event-level mapping in phase 2.
- SHA256 hashed customer_id is acceptable. We will send a short attestation from our security team confirming no PII is passed to GCP connector.

Next steps:
- We will review the measurement_matrix.xlsx and mp-onboarding-checklist.pdf and respond with any redlines by EOD Tuesday.
- Can Kimberly / Vivek propose two slots for the Tue alignment (30m)?

Appreciate the fast turnaround — excited to get this running.

Best,
Ethan Shaw
